div.head: Wif Inscr.
div.ab: Hu man mæden weddian sceal; 7 hwylce forewarde þær aghon to beonne.
Concerning the Betrothal of a Woman
Von Verlobung einer Frau (Wie man ein Mädchen verloben soll; und welche Verträge dabei sein müssen B).
Of the betrothal of a woman (How a maiden shall be betrothed; and what agreements must be made in it, B).
div.note: Liebermann prints H (Textus Roffensis f. 94v, after Norðleod, c. 1120) and B (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 383, p. 84, after A Gu, c. 1125). K is B; H is also given here. Both headings are in red; B's is not original. Liebermann calls this a private work, favourable to the bride's side; the archetype of H and B already shows forms of c. 1075, the original already has Norse loanwords; what Edgar's reform and Cnut still demanded holds here (8 f.). He dates it c. 970 (1030?)–c. 1060. In B ‘aghon’ the ‘a’ is illegible through a stain. Italics removed from the clause number for consistency.
This heading is in C.C.C.C., MS. 383. Textus Roffensis has “Concerning the betrothal of a woman”.
